Rubber Training Bumper Plates

$32.00$20.80

The YORK Rubber Training Bumper Plates are built for the lifts that make you stronger and the confidence to keep progressing. Whether you’re learning Olympic lifts, building strength, or training for overall fitness, these durable rubber plates help protect your equipment and flooring while delivering reliable performance for every workout.

Description

Your weight plates should inspire confidence, not hesitation. The YORK Rubber Training Bumper Plates are designed to help you train harder while protecting the equipment and space you’ve invested in. Their durable solid rubber construction reduces noise and cushions impact, making them an excellent choice for Olympic lifts, deadlifts, and everyday strength training at home. A reinforced steel center sleeve allows for smooth loading and unloading on any 2” Olympic bar, while the comfortable rubber exterior makes handling plates easy between sets. Built with the durability YORK is known for, these bumper plates are ready to support years of lifting, learning, and getting stronger.
